task: Read-only review of bounded precision draft replacement

findings.title: Apply remains enabled after an oversized replacement is rejected
findings.detail: The bounded setter stores .oversizedDraft and preserves the previous draft. apply() returns for that error at line 214, but the Apply button has no .disabled modifier. Consequently it remains visually and accessibly enabled while its action cannot apply a value. This fails the requested rejected-replacement disabled-state behavior and gives an enabled no-op control.
findings.recommendation: Disable Apply while inputError is .oversizedDraft, retain the apply() guard for keyboard submissions, and check that a subsequent bounded edit clears the error and re-enables Apply.
findings.evidenceScope: Source inspection; native rendered state was not executed.
